## Walkthrough

This PR implements wall-clock delay batching for context-only iterations in PyExecutor. A new `batch_wait_delay_timeout_ms` configuration parameter controls deadline-based batching when enabled alongside required settings. New executor state and three helper functions coordinate deadline evaluation, cross-rank skip synchronization, and KV cache reversion. Modified scheduling and main loop paths conditionally skip iterations and revert allocations.

## Changes

**Wall-Clock Delay Batching Feature**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Configuration Parameter and Validation** <br> `tensorrt_llm/llmapi/llm_args.py`, `tests/unittest/api_stability/references/llm.yaml`, `tests/unittest/llmapi/test_llm_args.py`|New `batch_wait_delay_timeout_ms` Pydantic field on `TorchLlmArgs` with validator enforcing mutual exclusion from `batch_wait_timeout_iters`, requirement for `disable_overlap_scheduler=True`, positive `batch_wait_max_tokens_ratio`, and set `max_num_tokens`. API stability reference and four validation tests confirm constraints.|
|**Executor State and Batch-Wait Initialization** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/py_executor.py` (lines 1–430)|SPDX header, refined batch-waiting enablement logic incorporating `batch_wait_delay_timeout_ms` via `enable_batch_wait_timeout`, new `batch_wait_deadline_s` state for deadline tracking, and `_skip_current_iteration` flag to mark iterations for skipping.|
|**Delay-Batching and Sync Helper Functions** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/py_executor.py` (lines 3628–3679)|Three internal helpers: `_waiting_context_requests_with_timeout` evaluates deadline and token threshold to decide skip, `_sync_delay_batch_skip` coordinates skip across ranks using TP allgather and gates on generation presence, `_clear_scheduled_requests_for_skip` reverts KV cache allocations and resets scheduled lists.|
|**Schedule Logic for Delay-Batching** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/py_executor.py` (lines 3690–3759)|Modified `_schedule` detects context-only batches, applies deadline-based waiting, computes synchronized skip decisions preventing skip if generation exists, and conditionally reverts scheduled requests, drops fitting disagg-gen-init requests, and marks iteration skip when batches are held.|
|**Main Loop Integration for Iteration Skipping** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/py_executor.py` (lines 2410–2633)|`_prepare_and_schedule_batch` early-returns with zero scheduled requests when skip flag is set; `_executor_loop` skips forward/sample/response handling by continuing when flag is true.|
|**Test Coverage for Delay-Batching Behavior** <br> `tests/unittest/_torch/executor/test_py_executor.py`|SPDX header and updated imports; five test methods covering context-only deadline behavior (skip before deadline, release after or at token target), `_sync_delay_batch_skip` rank coordination and attention DP gating, `_schedule` skip marking for context-only timeouts, and `_clear_scheduled_requests_for_skip` resets with v2 allocation reversion.|

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~22 minutes
